title: Raw MiniQMT order APIs can bypass strategy ledger attribution controls
description:
Expected: In multi-strategy miniQMT operation, normal strategy execution must enter through /api/v1/qmt/virtual-strategies managed order APIs so every broker order has a registered virtual strategy, unique order_remark, local order_intent, cash/lot preflight, and sync attribution. Raw /api/v1/qmt/order and /api/v1/qmt/order/batch should be restricted to explicit administrator/POC diagnostics with strong warnings or separate switches.
Actual: backend/routers/qmt.py exposes raw /order and /order/batch endpoints that accept optional strategy_name and order_remark and call miniQMT directly. 2026-05-18 POC showed blank strategy_name raw orders are accepted by the raw endpoint and then become unattributed or hard to reconcile. This bypasses the managed ledger design and can silently pollute multi-strategy accounting if used outside controlled POC.
required_verification: Router test: raw /api/v1/qmt/order rejects or requires an explicit admin/POC switch for blank strategy_name in multi-strategy mode.
Router test: raw /api/v1/qmt/order/batch rejects or requires an explicit admin/POC switch for blank strategy_name/order_remark in multi-strategy mode.
Regression test: managed /api/v1/qmt/virtual-strategies/orders remains the normal strategy path and records order_intent before broker call.
Reconciliation test: external/manual MiniQMT operations still become unattributed issues instead of silent strategy assignment.
Documentation/UI copy clearly marks raw endpoints as administrator/POC diagnostics only.
closure_requirements: Normal multi-strategy execution cannot bypass the AIstock managed ledger by accident.
Raw endpoint access policy is explicit, tested, and documented.
Unattributed raw/manual broker activity remains visible through reconciliation.
No existing diagnostic capability is silently removed without a replacement/admin path.

events.note: POC evidence: .codex_tmp/miniqmt_poc_monitor/poc_scenario_matrix_summary_20260518_140844.md records that raw /api/v1/qmt/order and /order/batch accepted blank strategy_name and must not be normal multi-strategy production entrypoints.

Business impact: P1 because it can create unattributed broker orders/trades and invalidate strategy-level cash/PnL; it is less urgent than P0 ledger correctness only because it can be mitigated operationally by not using raw endpoints.
Expected fix may be feature flag / admin-only route guard / UI warning / route-level deprecation for multi-strategy mode, not removal of diagnostic capability.
Required verification: raw endpoint requires explicit admin/POC switch or rejects blank strategy_name in multi-strategy mode; managed endpoint remains the only documented normal strategy path.
Required verification: reconciliation still records truly external/manual miniQMT operations as unattributed issues instead of silently assigning them.
Expanded from miniQMT issue coverage audit with explicit verification and closure requirements before code fixes.
